IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: org 'polaris' (org_id: org-873) exceeding org-level rate limits. 5m QPS ~1,200 (baseline ~200). 429s increasing. Pager: @ingrid

ingrid: I'm on it — joining the call. Any query patterns?

sam-sre: /v1/generate from polaris-prod key is the source. High concurrency from a few IP blocks. 99p latency ok, errors are 429. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ORGQPS/polaris

csm-jen: Customer reported incident via support #54321 — production impact, revenue affected. They've paused a subset of requests client-side but errors persist.

ingrid: Triage checklist: 1) quick RL bump for org to reduce 429s; 2) start traffic shaping for non-critical routes; 3) notify CSM for business approval; 4) create mitigation ticket.

ingrid: Executing temporary soft quota bump now. Command:
```bash
rbctl org update --org polaris --rate-limit 5000 --burst 1000 --reason "Emergency spike mitigation"
```

opsbot: Applying org change... SUCCESS. New org rate-limit=5000 burst=1000. Applied to pool: ded-us-west-1. (action_id: act-20260317-01)

sam-sre: Also steering heavy batch traffic to backup pool via routing override to reduce tail load on primary GPUs. Patch snippet: 
```json
{"route":"polaris","policy":"route-to-backup","weights":{"ded-us-west-1":0.7,"ded-us-west-2":0.3}}
```

mike-platform: Can we limit this to 2 hours max? Need CSM sign-off to avoid cost surprises.

csm-jen: Approved for 2 hours. Prioritize availability.

ingrid: Monitoring metrics — 10m after bump: 429 rate down ~88%, request success up. Token spend +30% (noted). Will recommend caching and model-size config to customer post-incident.

ingrid: Creating follow-up runbook ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DOC-998 (contains steps taken and rollback plan). Handoff to night oncall @mike-platform in 30m.

mike-platform: Acknowledged handoff. If we see another spike, plan: 1) apply targeted route disable for non-critical endpoints; 2) if still unhealthy, initiate org-level graceful shed.

sam-sre: Example graceful-shed command (non-blocking):
```bash
rbctl org set-route-state --org polaris --route /autocomplete --state disabled --reason "emergency shedding"
```

opsbot: Logs archived: s3://redwood-incident-logs/polaris/1769999999/ (gzipped).

csm-jen: Customer update: "Errors have returned to normal range, large batch jobs still queued." They asked for a short post-mortem and recommendations.

ingrid: Marking mitigated. We'll keep the temporary bump until the scheduled rollback at +2h (automated job DOC-998). Handoff complete. Closing operational thread — postmortem + customer recommendations to be drafted by eng-ml + solutions.

opsbot: Incident closed by ingrid at 1769991299. Reaction: :white_check_mark:
